eb58e14fc5a41df9.invariant: A Copilot session manifest (turns + files) can be folded as a full stochastic base via rib_bus.publish_rib(): one content-addressed RIB per surfaced invariant, so the next run mounts them (rib_bus.mount) and starts fresh from them instead of a blank prompt.

8010f3fb84f18561.invariant: Auto-ingest pattern: read session store (sessions/turns/session_files), run ghost_talk.reply() to route, then rib_bus.publish_rib(each invariant, domain=<ask>, source=<session>). Full stochastic base = the mounted RIB set + enqueued stochastic parts to the swarm.

ca3bae4ceb2fdaf6.invariant: The 'cache errors' are not exceptions — they are low cache-hit-ratio DeepSeek calls (cache_miss_tokens high, cache_hit_tokens 0) + occasional 'timed out' provider_chat rows in logs/usage.jsonl. Diagnose via cache_map which buckets cost+miss onto verkle sessions; fix by keeping prefixes frozen (cache-shared) and routing fresh-context asks away from the shared cache.
